item.title: Unscheduled Care Data Flags Patients at High Risk of Liver Disease
item.description: Unscheduled care attendance data provides an opportunity to identify patients at high risk of liver disease, a 2026 study has found. The post Unscheduled Care Data Flags Patients at High Risk of Liver Disease appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Hamate Bone Autograft Rebuilds Proximal Scaphoid
item.description: Proximal hamate autograft reconstructed a proximal scaphoid non-union after recurrent fixation, achieving union within 10.0 weeks. The post Hamate Bone Autograft Rebuilds Proximal Scaphoid appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Caffeinated Coffee Linked to Lower Dementia Risk
item.description: A large prospective study in JAMA finds higher caffeinated coffee and tea intake is associated with lower dementia risk and modestly better cognitive function over decades of follow-up. The post Caffeinated Coffee Linked to Lower Dementia Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Intermittent Fasting Shows Little Benefit for Weight Loss
item.description: A review of 22 trials finds intermittent fasting offers little to no additional weight loss benefit compared with regular dietary advice in adults with overweight or obesity. The post Intermittent Fasting Shows Little Benefit for Weight Loss appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Influenza Hijacks Immune Cells to Damage Heart
item.description: New study reveals how influenza virus infiltrates heart tissue via specialised immune cells, triggering damaging interferon responses. The post Influenza Hijacks Immune Cells to Damage Heart appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: GLP 1 Receptor Agonists Reduce Endometrial Cancer Risk
item.description: Large cohort study shows GLP 1 receptor agonists combined with progestins lower endometrial cancer risk and reduce hysterectomy incidence in women with benign uterine disease. The post GLP 1 Receptor Agonists Reduce Endometrial Cancer Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New WHO Handbook for Global STI Prevention
item.description: The WHO’s new handbook offers practical guidance to strengthen STI prevention, improve care delivery, and address rising global infection rates effectively. The post New WHO Handbook for Global STI Prevention appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: 5 minutes with Dr Stefanie Rau, Nestlé Health Science
item.description: Stefanie Rau, Global Medical Affairs Manager, Healthy Ageing, unpacks why it’s never too early to invest in your health. The post 5 minutes with Dr Stefanie Rau, Nestlé Health Science appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Lung Cancer in Never Smokers Needs a New Approach
item.description: Lung cancer in never smokers is rising, with distinct risks and biology, highlighting the need for tailored screening, prevention, and treatment. The post Lung Cancer in Never Smokers Needs a New Approach appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Repeat R CHOP Improves Late Relapse Lymphoma Outcomes
item.description: A second course of R CHOP achieved durable responses in late relapse diffuse large B cell lymphoma, especially in patients relapsing more than 5 years after diagnosis. The post Repeat R CHOP Improves Late Relapse Lymphoma Outcomes appeared first on European Medical Journal.
